info.name: Google Chrome Management App Details Telemetry Users API

params.name: customerId
params.description: Google Workspace customer ID. Use 'my_customer' to refer to the customer associated with the authenticated admin.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Maximum number of results to return.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: Token to specify next page in the result set.

params.name: filter
params.description: Filter to restrict results. Supports filtering by user email and org unit.

params.name: readMask
params.description: Fields to include in the response.

items.docs: Lists all telemetry users for a customer. Retrieves user-level telemetry data including user email, user devices, and user activity information on managed ChromeOS devices.

params.name: customerId
params.description: Google Workspace customer ID. Use 'my_customer' to refer to the customer associated with the authenticated admin.

params.name: userId
params.description: Unique identifier of the telemetry user.

params.name: readMask
params.description: Fields to include in the response.

items.docs: Retrieves a single telemetry user by their resource name. Returns detailed user-level telemetry data for the specified managed user.
